disposition_reason: Feed-supplement study of a germanium-containing aluminosilicate (36 ppm Ge as stated) with immune and antiviral endpoints in mice and pigs; no germanium concentrations measured in any matrix.
disposition_locator: Materials and Methods p. 136; Results p. 138

study.design: controlled feeding experiments in mice and in virus-challenged pigs
study.method: Germanium not measured; immune endpoints by MTT assay and flow cytometry; virus titers by plaque assay

unresolved: Germanium content of the supplement (36 ppm) is a stated composition of supplied material, not an analytical result, and was not recorded as a finding.
non_numeric_findings: Authors propose germanium biotite as a feed supplement to promote immune activity (abstract).
Authors attribute part of the effect to aluminosilicate acting as a non-specific immunostimulant (p. 140).
